## Summary

Describe the focused behavior or documentation change.

## Validation

- [ ] `make lint`
- [ ] `make test`
- [ ] `make build` on Apple Silicon
- [ ] Physical connect/disconnect test, when display behavior changed
- [ ] Emergency restore and uninstall remain fail-safe

## Test environment

List the macOS, Mac, UU Remote, MonitorControl, display, cable, and dock versions relevant to this change. Do not include account, device, IP, or display serial-number data.
